timing_scope: Parent wall: complete fresh subprocess, imports + file reads + content hashes + cache validation + model integrity/load when needed + extraction + comparison + JSON output. Model/data downloads excluded. CPU + peak RSS: Linux wait4 resource usage for the complete child, including output serialization.
limitations: Application cache cleared for first/full runs; OS page cache not cleared.
Shared host; fixed CPU affinity and threads do not isolate other workloads.
Sequential single-image inference; first forward/JIT costs included.
Cold/warm describe application feature cache, not OS cache.
Model loaded lazily only when features are missing.
Incremental run rehashes all files to detect changes; it extracts only new content.
No energy, monetary cost, FLOPs, or GPU measurements.
